message: The *Goblin Barrel* brigade led by **raquaza** and **Vijay** is taking no prisoners, launching us into Magic Academy’s lofty heights! Huge props to **Chanco** for topping donation charts yet again — your *Baby Dragon* is the real MVP. **King Levy** is putting those *Arrows* to good use, firmly in control of battle strategy. Kudos to our warriors like **Ditaka** and **JaxikoLane** who've already battled today. For those who haven't, now's the time to unleash your **Mini P.E.K.K.A** and push us closer to River Race glory. Keep those decks tight and towers standing tall — on to victory! 🏆
